paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 7.12, representing a 21.09 percent change from the prior close and a 12.84 percent change over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 8 new news articles about the company in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include an agreement between Fermi and Hillcore for a 2.6 GW power center at Project Matador Campus in Texas, as reported by Construction Review and Seeking Alpha. Other sources such as Bisnow and The Lufkin Daily News also reported on the project, with Bisnow noting that Fermi finally landed its first tenant for the data center campus.

There have been 25 total filings, including 1 Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form disclosing the appointment of new officers, an 8-K/A form disclosing the resignation of director Miles Everson, and an 8-K form disclosing the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
